title: Current-window sensitivity of profit target x SOXX-RSI exit, I25/R25 fixed, NEXT_OPEN only (68 evaluation cells)
model_assignment: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (per docs/tasks/EXIT_FACTORIAL_CURRENT_SONNET55_REQUEST.md); actual serving model not independently verifiable from inside the run
purpose: Answer 'is +20% too low / should the OR-RSI threshold be lower' inside the already-known current window only. This is a sensitivity check on a known period; it is NOT an unused OOS and NOT evidence about other market periods. No data are fetched; the 052ee96 Adj Close fills / interval-mean IRX and the 737ef35 Close wrapper are not used.

design.rsi_definition: engine's own RSI: Wilder RSI(14) of the SOXX Adj Close series as built in load(); unchanged period/smoothing/missing handling
design.profit_definition: D-close stock market value / cost-inclusive basis - 1 >= target (closeTargetNet=false); the sale then needs the engine's original post-hoc net-of-cost pre-tax 2% gate at the next session Open. A fired signal does not mean a >=20% (or target) gain is realised at the fill.
design.allocation: initial I=25%, after-sale R=25% fixed for all sell candidates (initialRatio 0.25, reentryRatio 0.25, reentry 0.25)
design.execution: NEXT_OPEN only (original saved Open; engine unchanged)
design.common_options: identical to 77bb44f run.mjs baseOpts: initial 10000, allowInitialReentry true, dividendSchedule fixed, dividendMode issuer_exact_pay_date_proxy, mmfRate 0.03 fixed scenario, closeTargetNet false, buffer 0, slippage 0. Tax 20.315%, USDJPY 150, integer shares, cost-inclusive basis, normal/ExFear buys ON.
design.excluded: RSI_ONLY, AND, trailing, partial sale, additional thresholds / ratios / starts / terminals / slippage

cells_68.formula: (4 profit targets x 4 RSI options + 1 control) x 2 starts x 2 delays = 68

reused_from_stored_77bb44f.composition: PROFIT_ONLY R25 x4 targets x4 conditions = 16; P20_OR_R75 R25 x4 = 4; NO_SELL_I25 x4 = 4

new_simulations.composition: OR candidates at 11 (target, RSI) pairs (all OR pairs except 20/75) x 4 conditions

regression_simulations.composition: P20_ONLY R25 and P20_OR_R75 R25 x 2 starts x 2 delays, compared with stored values
regression_simulations.role: harness check; also supplies explanatory ledger rows for those two candidates

cells_68.not_recomputed: the other 16 stored cells (30/40/60 PROFIT_ONLY and NO_SELL) are not re-simulated; no extra synthetic simulation; no re-run of 48/954/216

outputs.summary.csv: 68 rows: candidate, start, delay, reused/new, source sha, market value, same-day after-tax liquidation, difference vs principal, terminal liquidation cost/tax (for reused cells derived from stored final shares and the 2026-08-10 close, identity-checked), realised tax, fees, MMF and dividends after tax, cash, shares, basis, trade counts, blocked sales
outputs.profit_effects.csv: 12 rows: PROFIT_ONLY 30/40/60 minus 20, per start x delay (stored values only)
outputs.rsi_effects.csv: 48 rows: per target, RSI 70/75/80 minus no-RSI, per start x delay; assets are never summed across starts
outputs.interaction_effects.csv: 36 rows: (RSI effect at target 30/40/60) - (RSI effect at target 20), per start x delay; differences within this fixed input, no statistical significance implied
outputs.ledger_new_and_regression.csv: from the in-memory ledgers of the 44 new + 8 regression runs only: D date, exec date, D profit rate, SOXX RSI, profit_hit, rsi_hit, signal class (both / profit-only / RSI-only), FILLED / BLOCKED, realised profit rate, tax, fees. Counts of classes are path descriptions, not unique causal contributions. Engine is not instrumented; anything the engine state does not expose is UNOBSERVED
outputs.explained_paths: at most 6, chosen by this rule fixed now from the 52 executed runs: for start 2024-10-01 delay 0 and start 2025-01-02 delay 0, (a) highest same-day after-tax liquidation, (b) lowest, (c) P20_ONLY R25 (regression) as the reference. Whole tables are kept. No additional run after results.

checks_planned: input / engine / dividend / stored-summary / specification sha256 equal source_refs.json
regression 8: amounts within 1e-6 USD, dates / quantities / counts identical to stored 77bb44f

all 44 new + 8 regression runs: accounting identity, market value vs liquidation identity, cash >= 0, integer shares, zero shares => zero basis, every filled sale net gain >= 2% of cost, no dividend entitlement/payment double count, start and terminal date, fresh account at start

each sale signal: D (signal date) strictly before the exec date; PROFIT_ONLY signals have D gross profit >= target; OR signals have profit_hit or rsi_hit; fill price equals the original Open of the exec date
fg_used equals signals(delay) (row i-delay), never raw D.fg for delay 1
reused cells: derived terminal liquidation cost / tax satisfy liquidation = total - cost - tax
simulate call count equals 52 (44 new + 8 regression)
judging_order: profit target alone -> RSI alone -> combination. No conclusion that a higher target requires a lower RSI is assumed. The best value per condition may be shown; win counts, mean rank and max drawdown are not objectives. Objective: final total assets, same-day after-tax liquidation first, market value alongside.
caveats: post-hoc 2% gate and next-Open-known quantity decisions are diagnostic; historical F&G as-of unverified (delay 0 is not a morning observation); MMF 3% and dividend pay-date proxy are scenarios; real-account tax class and fund availability unverified; liquidation is a valuation, not an order; starts overlap in market period; known window, not OOS
stop_condition: 68 cells saved and explained, then stop. No data retrieval, no network retry, no new thresholds, no automatic follow-up exploration.
